assessment.nobel_worthiness: A foundational framework for understanding collateral constraints, credit cycles and macroeconomic amplification.
assessment.attribution: Kiyotaki and Moore are the central originators of the core collateral-cycle mechanism.
assessment.maturity: The mechanism has long shaped macro-finance theory and analysis of financial crises.
uncertainties: The broader financial-accelerator literature creates questions about the appropriate boundary of the prize.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: The heterogeneous-firm trade framework transformed modern trade theory and empirical work on adjustment and gains from trade.
assessment.attribution: Melitz is the indispensable originator of the canonical selection-and-productivity framework; related contributors merit careful consideration.
assessment.maturity: The framework is deeply integrated into trade research and policy analysis.
uncertainties: A final formulation would need to delimit credit relative to earlier new-trade theory and subsequent quantitative work.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Their political-economy analysis made organized interests and incentives central to rigorous explanations of trade policy.
assessment.attribution: Helpman and Grossman form a clear, closely connected intellectual partnership for the stated contribution.
assessment.maturity: The work is longstanding, influential and remains a basic reference point in political economy and trade.
uncertainties: The contribution overlaps with their wider bodies of work in trade and political economy.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Dynamic-panel GMM methods supplied widely used tools for credible estimation with persistent outcomes and unobserved heterogeneity.
assessment.attribution: Arellano and Bond are central to the original estimator, while Blundell and Bond are central to the system-GMM extension.
assessment.maturity: These methods have been extensively used and scrutinized across applied economics for decades.
uncertainties: Practical misuse and finite-sample sensitivity complicate assessment of the net methodological legacy.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Quantile regression fundamentally broadened econometric analysis from conditional means to distributional effects.
assessment.attribution: Koenker and Bassett are the original and unmistakable architects of quantile regression.
assessment.maturity: The method has had durable theoretical and empirical influence across economics and related fields.
uncertainties: The scope of credit for later distributional econometrics requires careful delimitation.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: The misallocation program supplied an influential quantitative account of how distorted factor allocation can affect aggregate productivity and income differences.
assessment.attribution: Hsieh, Klenow and Restuccia made closely related central contributions to measurement and macroeconomic interpretation.
assessment.maturity: The approach has generated a large literature and disciplined debate about productivity gaps.
uncertainties: The causal interpretation of measured wedges and the size of implied gains remain contested.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Alternating-offers bargaining and bargaining-in-markets models provided fundamental tools for strategic analysis.
assessment.attribution: Rubinstein is central to the alternating-offers solution, with Wolinsky a major contributor to bargaining and market applications.
assessment.maturity: The work is canonical and has influenced theory throughout economics.
uncertainties: A final prize would need to determine whether the stated package is sufficiently unified and how to recognize related bargaining contributions.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Heterogeneous-agent New Keynesian models substantially changed analysis of monetary and fiscal transmission across households.
assessment.attribution: Moll, Violante and Kaplan are highly visible contributors to the modern quantitative framework.
assessment.maturity: The framework has become influential in macroeconomic research and policy work, though it is comparatively recent.
uncertainties: The field is still evolving, making the durable attribution of a distinct foundational contribution less settled.
